source.document: Keithley Model 485 Autoranging Picoammeter - Instruction Manual (485-901-01 Rev. F)
source.pages: Verification procedure p. 3-1; Table 3-1, Figure 3-1 and Table 3-2 p. 3-2; Zero Check p. 2-4; Specifications (front of the manual)
source.cite: Keithley 485 Instruction Manual, Table 3-2 Range Accuracy, p. 3-2
source.limits: Printed in Table 3-2 (Allowable Readings, 18-28 °C); checked against the published 1-year accuracy
source.report_note: Keithley 485 performance verification, Section 3.5 and Table 3-2 of the Instruction Manual: each range is driven by a DC calibrator through a measured resistor (calibrator setting V = I x R), positive and negative current. Limits are the Allowable Readings of Table 3-2.
source.note: Table 3-2: 7 ranges, positive and negative current (14 points) plus the zero check. The DC calibrator (Fluke 5560A, 5522A or 5520A) sources V = I x R through the lab's resistance box (measured values in specs/build_keithley_485_spec.py); the technician selects the range and types the reading.

485.name: Keithley 485
485.model_note: Keithley Model 485 Autoranging Picoammeter (4 1/2 digit, 2 nA to 2 mA)

R10.title: Set up for the 2 nA range: resistance box at 10^10
R10.summary: Calibrator NORMAL HI / LO -> resistance box at 10^10 (9.93242 GΩ) in the shielded fixture -> low-noise coax -> 485 INPUT. 485 on the 2 nA range.
steps: Standby
The calibrator is put in STANDBY before you change the resistor (in manual-calibrator mode, put it in STANDBY yourself).
Resistor

Set the resistance box to the 10^10 position (measured value 9.93242 GΩ). It must be in a shielded (metal) enclosure, as the test fixture of Figure 3-1 (p. 3-2). The calibrator setting is calculated from this measured value.
Calibrator

Calibrator output HI -> resistor input (+), output LO -> the fixture LO (-), which is the BNC shield; the fixture case to the calibrator ground (Figure 3-1: three banana jacks +, - and ground). (Which calibrator ground terminal: UNVERIFIED.)
485 input
Fixture BNC output -> 485 INPUT with a low-noise coaxial cable such as the Keithley 4801 (step 8, p. 3-1). Keep the cable still during the reading.
485 range
Release ZERO CHECK, REL and LOG off, then press the 2 nA range button (manual range, not AUTO).
R10.caution: The calibrator applies about 19 V DC to the fixture. Do not exceed 30 V rms between the 485 input low and chassis ground (p. 2-3).

steps.title: Zero check (2nA range, ZERO CHECK locked in)
steps.setup: Warm up the 485 for one hour (3.4, p. 3-1). INPUT open: no cable on the 485 INPUT. Select the 2nA range, REL and LOG off, press ZERO CHECK in to the locked position, adjust the front-panel ZERO trimpot for .0000 +/- 1 count, then release ZERO CHECK (steps 4 and 5, p. 3-1; 2.7.2, p. 2-4). The calibrator has no output.
steps.question: The 485 reads .0000 +/- 1 count on the 2nA range with ZERO CHECK in (after the ZERO adjustment).
